question: Blood has a fluid matrix called ________, in which RBCs, WBCs and platelets are suspended.
solution:
The correct answer is **Plasma**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plasma** is the liquid component of blood that holds the blood cells in suspension.
 
• It makes up about 55% of the body's total blood volume.
 
• Plasma is composed mostly of water (about 90%), along with proteins, glucose, electrolytes, hormones, and waste products.
 
• It serves as a medium for transporting nutrients, hormones, and proteins to the parts of the body that need them.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 **Cerebrospinal fluid** is a clear, colorless body fluid found in the brain and spinal cord.
 
 

 Option 2
 **Saliva** is a watery secretion in the mouth that aids in digestion and keeps the mouth moist.
 
 

 Option 3
 **Plasma** is the fluid matrix of blood, in which RBCs, WBCs, and platelets are suspended.
 
 

 Option 4
 **Lymph** is a clear fluid that circulates through the lymphatic system and helps in immune functions.
